title: Initialize 48-byte matrix basis
summary: Recovered VA 0x438420 as a void member method writing three four-float groups with unit diagonal and positive-zero remaining elements. Direct original disassembly agrees with accepted reference; callers supply ECX and ignore return registers.
test_description: Compare original thiscall reference and recovered member over 128 prior byte patterns under six MXCSR settings, including NaNs, infinities, signed zero and subnormals. Check exact twelve output words, full guarded object equality, unchanged before/after fields, idempotence and unchanged MXCSR.
known_limits: Row versus column interpretation and enclosing object type are unresolved; storage offsets are preserved.
Requires valid writable 48-byte float object; invalid-pointer fault behavior and concurrent observation are outside the portable contract.
No byte-match claim; EAX is unspecified by the original and is not treated as a return value.
